character_fit.label: Fitness proportions
character_fit.reason: The short-arm rest character uses the validated fitness proportions for a supported bench grip.

timing.source: declared demonstration tempo; not measured from source photographs

correction.foot_orientation: neutral fitted rest soles on fixed floor marks

planted_feet.method: fitted rest heel/toe plantar patches, full evaluated surface on every frame

bench_profile.method: explicit fixed-grip shoulder-lockout to lower-chest trajectory, using recorded reference phase timing; source depth is uncalibrated

upper_arm_roll.method: fixed mirrored humerus roll from the fitted clavicle rest frame; solved distal transforms retained

contacts.grip_source: declared medium-grip bench profile; not calibrated from source photographs
contacts.grip_calibration: The model uses a declared two-shoulder-width span; source width and depth remain uncalibrated.

rows.note: Reach adaptation changes the photographed equipment path.
Conservative shaft/body surface samples; overlap candidates need visual review.
Both elbows must reach at least 175 degrees at the recorded lockout.
Both elbows must bend to at most 105 degrees at the lower-chest position.
The lower-chest position must not overfold either elbow below 65 degrees.
The bar must complete a meaningful vertical press, not remain beside the face.
The wrists must stay above their elbows with forearms within 30 degrees of vertical.
The shaft must remain in the shoulder-to-chest corridor rather than moving over the neck or abdomen.
The bottom must reach the lower chest, not remain over the shoulders or neck.
The completed press must return the bar over the shoulder line.
Each stroke must follow one press path without wandering or reversing direction.
The supported torso and pelvis stay stationary during the press.
Both arms must press together.
Both heel and toe patches stay planted throughout the press.
Feet must reach the floor.
Feet must reach the floor.
